steps: Open the Command Palette and run "Code: Open Settings".
Click "Runtime" in the Settings navigation, then scroll to "Where your data goes".
Read each row for where it is processed: "Local models" (this computer), "Your own provider key" (that provider), "AGI Cloud" (AGI servers, then the provider serving the chosen model).
Compare with Expected: each feature should say on device, AGI cloud or a named provider; the AGI Cloud row names no provider, only "the provider that serves the model you picked".
S41.20.where: Code: Open Settings > Runtime > Where your data goes
